messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
tiel mi igis min besto sen ripozo, ke venante kontraŭ mi iom post iom mi puŝis min reen tien kie la suno silentas.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| # | Source Word | Contextual Definition (Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Step 2) | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |---|-------------|--------------------------------|------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | 1 | tal | “such” – demonstrative adjective | tiel | “thus / so” | OK | | 2 | mi (line 58) | “me” – 1st‑person pronoun (object) | mi | “me” (subject of *igis*) | OK | | 3 | fece | “made” – causative verb | igis | “made / caused” | OK | | 4 | la | “the” – definite article | *(none)* | – | **WRONG** (article omitted) | | 5 | bestia | “beast” – noun | besto | “beast” | OK | | 6 | sanza | “without” – preposition | sen | “without” | OK | | 7 | pace | “repose” – noun | ripozo | “rest / repose” | OK | | 8 | che | “that” – relative pronoun | ke | “that” (conjunction) | OK | | 9 | venendomi | “coming on against me” – gerund + clitic | venante **+** kontraŭ mi | “coming, against me” | OK | |10 | ’ncontro | “against” – preposition | kontraŭ | “against” | OK | |11 | a (first) | part of idiom “a poco a poco” – incremental marker | *(none)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** (idiom expressed by “iom post iom”) | |12 | poco (first) | “little” – adverb of degree | iom | “a little” | OK | |13 | a (second) | part of idiom “a poco a poco” – incremental marker | *(none)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** | |14 | poco (second) | “little” – adverb of degree | iom | “a little” | OK | |15 | mi (line 60) | “me” – 1st‑person pronoun (subject) | mi | “I / me” | OK | |16 | ripigneva | “was pushing” – imperfect verb | puŝis | “pushed” | OK | |17 | là | “thither” – adverb of place | tien | “there / thither” | OK | |18 | dove | “where” – relative adverb of place | kie | “where” | OK | |19 | ’l | “the” – definite article (elided) | la | “the” | OK | |20 | sol | “Sun” – noun | suno | “Sun” | OK | |21 | tace | “is silent” – verb | silentas | “is silent” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **WRONG**: **la** (line 58) – the definite article required in Esperanto is missing before *besto*; the clause should read “… la beston …* or “… beston …” with proper accusative. - **GRAMMAR** (implicit): The construction *“tiel mi igis mi n besto”* is ungrammatical in Esperanto; a correct resultative would be *“tiel mi igis min esti besto”* or *“tiel mi igis min beston”*. This is reflected in the **WRONG** status for the missing article and the overall clause. - **UNNECESSARY**: Both occurrences of the preposition **a** that belong to the Italian idiom *a poco a poco* are not needed in Esperanto because the idiom is rendered by *iom post iom*. - No other **MISSING**, **WRONG**, **GRAMMAR**, or **UNNECESSARY** items were found.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 58** - Original: tiel mi igis min besto sen ripozo, - Issue: Missing definite article and resultative case; should be “la beston”. - Corrected: **tiel mi igis min la beston sen ripozo,**
- **Line 59** - Original: ke venante kontraŭ mi iom post iom - Issue: Missing end‑comma. - Corrected: **ke venante kontraŭ mi iom post iom,**
- **Line 60** - Original: mi puŝis min reen tien kie la suno silentas. - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
